findings.claim: Line 62 asks for proof that an active membership with no membership_roles is enough, but the reading list at lines 18-23 leaves out backend/app/src/detran-full-auth-roles.guard.ts. Its spec (detran-full-auth-roles.guard.spec.ts:150-199) shows the full-auth protocol reads auth.memberships, auth.membership_roles and auth.group_memberships from the database. The Engineer could cite only app.module/STYNX and report a false demonstration for routes under that guard.
findings.fix: Add detran-full-auth-roles.guard.ts and its spec to the identity reading list. Require the report to state, for each of the four frontend routes (Portal, RAIT, Dashboard, TEAT) and the two CH probes without an actor, whether the guard applies. If any of them depends on membership_roles, report BLOCKED without inserting roles.

findings.claim: The report template lists ratified, corrected and reverted changes, but asks for no SHA-256 of the final files. The TASK-0006 ratification (reports/TASK-0006-delivery-ratify.md:5) recorded SHA-256 per artifact. Without hashes, the next delivery-review cannot tell whether the maestro's version was ratified unchanged or changed by the Engineer, which is the central point of delivery-review-CTG-0002.json:10.
findings.fix: Require the SHA-256 of each file in the write boundary (detran-stack.sh, smoke.mjs, portal-fixture.sh, sefaz-adapter-smoke.mjs, sefaz-mock.mjs) after the iteration. Mark which files are byte-for-byte identical to the maestro-adenda state.

findings.claim: Live smoke is forbidden (line 131), and ch-fixture.sh binds ch.professional.user_id and created_by to actor b0000002 (ch-fixture.sh:38,99). As a result, the default actor cannot be observed live on the biometric and council probes (RECEPCAO/ADMIN_CLINICA, which the TASK-0011 sensor at contract.test.mjs:571-580 now requires to run without an actor). The prompt tells the Engineer to report BLOCKED if ch-fixture needs to change (line 28), but does not require a static analysis that would find that dependency.
findings.fix: Require the report to cite, with file and line from BiometricLifecycleService.recordCheck and the council lifecycle, whether the principal's actor id is used in scope or preconditions before the adapter. Otherwise, record it explicitly as a risk for checkpoint (b).

findings.claim: The prompt requires inserting auth.users and auth.memberships for actor ...000000000002 (lines 55-60). It does not require proof that they are needed. A7 (plan.md:288-296) only allows them ('pode criar'). Extra auth data in the scratch database is harmless, but it is not justified.
findings.fix: Ask for a citation of the file and line that make membership necessary (the tenancy interceptor or a query that joins auth.users), or allow skipping the insertion with a justification.
